_note: Hand-written approximation of the Atlassian MCP connector's getJiraIssue schema; the real tools/list was not obtainable without credentials in the authoring session.

tools.name: getJiraIssue
tools.description: Get the details of a Jira issue by its key or id. Returns the issue resource including summary, description, status, assignee, labels and parent.

cloudId.description: Atlassian cloud id (optional when a single site is configured)

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue key such as HB-2041, or numeric id

fields.description: Fields to include; defaults to all navigable fields
